thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on prod-eu-edge starting now. Spike concentrated on TLS handshake failures (SNI/cert verify) across multiple pods. Error rate up ~11% over baseline for the last 2m. Paging oncall.

maya: acked. I'm oncall — joining. any customer-facing impact reported? @pagerduty?

pagerduty: Incident created: INC-2027-8743. Severity: P1. Impact: ~11% errors, some request timeouts to hosted API in eu-west.

maya: quick check — curl against edge LB shows `curl -v https://api.eu.redwood.ai/` returns TLS handshake failure intermittently. Collecting `openssl s_client -connect` and `tlsdump`.

maya: logs from gateway (snippet):
```
2027-06-03T09:12:05Z gateway[edge-2]: tls_handshake_error: x509: certificate has expired
2027-06-03T09:12:06Z gateway[edge-3]: handshake failed: tls: bad certificate
2027-06-03T09:12:07Z gateway[edge-1]: client auth failed: unknown ca
```

samir: that x509: certificate has expired line stands out. Which cert? leaf or intermediate?

maya: looks like intermediate CA `redwood-eu-int-2024` shows expiry at `2027-06-03T08:59:00Z` according to certchain pulled from the proxy config. Confirming with `openssl x509 -enddate` on the file.

lina: I see rotator logs: scheduled rotation ran yesterday but returned 500 from KMS decrypt for the new intermediate and fallback left the old chain in place. rotator log: `ERROR: decrypt: kms.Decrypt failed: permission denied`. Possibly IAM permission change in the deploy from last night.

aj: I'm switching to infra mode. If intermediate expired and rotator failed, we need immediate mitigation to reduce customer impact: 1) route traffic to us-west fallback pools (no cert expiry), 2) enable permissive TLS mode on eu-edge to allow ALPN passthrough (reduces client auth enforcement) until fix, 3) manual upload of a valid intermediate if we have one in vault. Thoughts?

maya: agree on order. I'll open a traffic-steer play: 30% -> us-west, 70% eu-edge with permissive TLS. Can we do a temporary policy in the edge router?

infra-sre: can do traffic steering via the config control plane. Executing `rbctl steer --from eu --to us-west --percent 30 --reason "mtls intermediate expiry"`. Applying now.

infra-sre: traffic steer applied. Monitoring metrics. Error rate dropped to ~6% within 40s. Still some downstream failures from long-lived connections.

maya: enabling permissive TLS on eu edge to bypass strict client cert validation for bearer token routes (customer-sensitive endpoints still require strict TLS). Pushing patch: `edge-config set tls.mode=permissive --route /v1/generate`.

maya: permissive TLS applied. Observing handshake success rate improve further to ~2.2%. Need to avoid exposing any customer cert-protected endpoints — limiting to non-mtls routes only.

samir: we should also rotate the intermediate ASAP. Lina, can you retry the rotator with elevated IAM role? If KMS decrypt failing due to IAM, escalate to cloud-admins now.

lina: on it. I requested `kms:Decrypt` for the rotator service account 5m ago; cloud-admins replied and are reapplying the policy. Will re-run rotation once perms confirmed.

aj: meanwhile create an incident timeline and customer impact note for CS: include root cause preliminary (expired intermediate + rotator KMS decrypt failure), mitigation (traffic steering + permissive TLS partial), and ETA for full fix. I'll take second shift at 9:40Z to finish.

maya: handoff to AJ at 2475554480. Summary for next oncall: 1) current state: traffic steer 30% to us-west, permissive TLS on eu-edge for non-mTLS routes, error rate ~2%. 2) immediate actions pending: rotate intermediate cert, verify rotator KMS perms, manual upload fallback cert if rotation fails. 3) customers notified: outbound CS alert queued (waiting approval). 4) logs to check: `gateway/*.log`, `rotator/*.log`, `kms/audit`.

aj: acked. I'll pick this up. If rotation can't complete within 20m, prepare manual cert push and plan for a full edge pod restart controlled rollout. Also will coordinate with CS on a brief customer note.

maya: adding temporary suppression to avoid noisy alerts for certificate-related 5xx while we mitigate: `alerts.silence add --alert tls-handshake-spike --until +30m --reason "active mitigation"`.

lina: cloud-admins confirmed IAM change; re-run rotation now. rotator: `INFO: rotation succeeded: new intermediate uploaded at 09:35Z`.

infra-sre: new chain propagated to edge; restarting edge pods in eu one-by-one to pick up new chain. Restart cadence 10s apart.

infra-sre: restart complete. Observed handshake errors drop to baseline ~0.3%.

maya: great. closing mitigation: traffic steer rolled back, permissive TLS removed, suppression removed. Preparing postmortem notes.

aj: taking incident lead for final writeup and customer comms. Assign postmortem owner: samir.

samir: will run root-cause analysis and include timelines, IAM policy change, rotator hardening steps, test rotation in staging, and an automated validity check before rotator runs.

maya: thanks team. marking incident resolved in the channel. :white_check_mark:
